title: The Wild Choir
author: Mirabel Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
